method: Current exported interview/state functions in a fresh isolated Node process; at most three user turns. No local server, UI, Realtime or microphone interaction.

turns.input: Can you help me check whether a shop has an item in stock?

output.reply: Sure, I can help with that. Could you please tell me the item you're looking for and the name or location of the shop?

turns.input: This is a fictional shop-call simulation. I am looking for a navy waterproof daypack with a capacity of about 20 litres. I do not have a particular brand in mind; any bag matching those specifications is fine. I am looking in Mapo, Seoul, and would like to pick it up this evening. Please check whether the matching item is currently in stock, its price, and the shop closing time or latest pickup time this evening.

output.reply: A simulation plan is ready to check for a navy waterproof daypack (about 20 litres, any brand) in Mapo, Seoul, for pickup this evening. Details for local shops are fictional and unconfirmed. May I proceed to simulate calling the listed stores to check current stock, price, and closing time or latest pickup time?

manualAudit.topicAndDynamicQuestions: Passed in this observed run: stock_check, price_inquiry and closing_time are generated for the actual shop request. No hospital symptoms, doctor, insurance or prior-visit questions appear.
manualAudit.customerFacts: Navy waterproof daypack, about20litres, any brand, Mapo/Seoul and evening pickup retain the supplied meanings and valid customer source IDs. No willingness to accept another color was added.
manualAudit.coverage: The stock question includes color, waterproof specification, daypack, approximate capacity, brand flexibility and evening pickup. Price and closing/latest-pickup questions are present. Korean translations preserve those clauses.
manualAudit.noInventedBusinessAnswers: No inventory count, stock confirmation, price or closing time is fabricated. All three answers remain unresolved, evidence empty, call idle and transcripts empty. Store names are explicitly Fictional and reasons ask unknowns.

wordingCaveat.quote: What is the price of the available navy waterproof daypack (about 20 litres)?
wordingCaveat.koreanQuote: 구매 가능한 네이비 방수 데이팩(약 20리터 용량)의 가격이 얼마인가요?
wordingCaveat.issue: The word available presupposes availability before any business response. It should be conditional on stock or use neutral product wording; the initial stock question does not itself establish availability. This is a plan wording limitation, not a fabricated stock answer in state.

manualAudit.repairObserved: The first detailed-turn candidate asked extra budget/material/features questions instead of preparing the actionable plan. Independent review rejected it; one bounded repair returned the shop-specific plan.
manualAudit.unknownRelay: Alternative-color acceptance deliberately remains unknown. The teammate guide proposes a conditional black-alternative question for a later live relay; no relay model or microphone was exercised in this interview check.
notVerified: Real shop facts or contact details
Completed shop call, purchase, reservation or final recommendation
manualAudit.boundaries: Exported-function test only; no localhost server/UI operation, no authorization, no Realtime connection and no frontend/source edits.
